crossRefs.note: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had…
For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case, and executes…
No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above…
We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

translations.web: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
translations.bsb: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
translations.kjv: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
translations.asv: He only is my rock and my salvation: He is my high tower; I shall not be greatly moved.
